name: Fog Garden
description: A quiet garden under mist. Clear the fog tile by tile and use the numbers to work out where the brambles hide. No timer, and a fresh start is always one press away.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A garden covered in fog: 7 by 7 with 8 brambles, 9 by 9 with 12 or 12 by 12 with 24. Some tiles hide thorny brambles. Clearing a tile shows how many of the up to eight tiles around it hide brambles.
help.goal: Clear every tile that does not hide a bramble. Mark the tiles you think hide brambles to keep track. There is no timer.
howToPlay: Reveal any tile to begin. The first tile you open is never a bramble, and neither are the tiles around it, so it always opens up an area.
A number tells you how many brambles are in the tiles around it. A blank tile has none, so its neighbours clear on their own.
Use the numbers to work out which tiles are safe and which hide brambles. Mark the ones you are sure of so you do not reveal them by accident.

If you reveal a bramble the fog simply closes in. Try again keeps the same field, New field gives a different one, and Today's field is the same for everyone today, with the middle already clear. Size switches between 7 by 7, 9 by 9 and 12 by 12 and deals a new field.

controls.action: Reveal the tile (or mark it in Mark mode)
Mark or unmark the tile as a bramble
Reach Mark mode, Try again, New field, Today's field and Size

tips: A 1 with only one hidden tile left beside it means that tile hides a bramble.
When a number matches the brambles you have already marked around it, the other tiles around it are safe.
Brambles left is the total minus your marks, so it can help you check your guesses.
You can stop at any time. Your field is saved and waits for you.
